# identity.UserPreferences

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Preferences of the signed-in user: locale, time zone, currency, theme and notifications.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.UserPreferences` |
| Kind | `settings` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | no | `personal` | Preferred ISO 4217 currency for display. |  |
| `locale` | no | `personal` | Preferred BCP 47 locale; absent uses the organization default. |  |
| `notifications` | yes | `none` | Notification opt-ins. |  |
| `theme` | yes | `none` | Color theme. |  |
| `timeZone` | no | `personal` | Preferred IANA time zone for display; absent uses the node's. |  |

## Relations

_None._

```json

  {
    "locale": "pt-BR",

    "notifications": {

      "securityAlerts": true
    }
  }
]
```
